==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}

[[File:Tuon.jpg|thumb|[[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], by [[John Seamas Gallagher]].]]

[[Mat]] and [[Noal Charin]] cross the [[Mol Hara]] square together, noticing the statue of long-dead Queen [[Nariene]]. They return to the [[Tarasin Palace]], and in order to avoid being questioned, they head in through a stable gate. The Palace that was once [[Tylin]]'s is now only hers in name. The High Lady [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] has taken residence there, as well as several other high [[Seanchan]] of the [[The Blood|High Blood]]. In a yard they pass while headed into the palace, several ''[[sul'dam]]'' are exercising their ''[[damane]]'', one of them is [[Teslyn Baradon]]. It has been a month and a half, Mat recalls, since the Seanchan took [[Ebou Dar]]. Mat takes the strange old man to the surviving [[Redarm]]s, and they welcome him to stay with them for as long as he likes - at least after they discover he saved Mat's life. Mat orders his men to find [[Talmanes]] and leave Ebou Dar on a ship, but every single one of them refuses to. Infuriated, Mat stalks upstairs to take a bath before Tylin finds him and stumbles into [[Juilin]]. He tells the thief-taker to leave, but he refuses, too! {{ref|[[Juilin]] refuses to leave because [[Amathera]] is present in the Palace}} Mat heads directly to Tylin's rooms, and as he opens the door, he is surprised not only by who is present, but that the dice in his head have come to such a thunderous stop as never before, though, it seems, nothing happened. Tylin attempts to dismiss him, but Mat is so surprised by the sudden end of the dice rolling, he just stands there. In the room with Tylin are [[Suroth]], [[Tuon]], [[Selucia]], and the mysterious [[Anath]], who barely has the all-too-familiar Seanchan drawl. {{ref|Why does [[Anath]] not have the distinctive Seanchan accent? Because she isn't one. She is in fact [[Semirhage]] in disguise. Apparently [[Ishamael]] does not give [[Mat]]'s and [[Perrin]]'s appearances to the other [[Forsaken]], as Semirhage later claims that she did not recognize him}} Tuon takes one look at him, and then seems to drink him in, inspecting him to the finest detail. {{ref|Why is [[Tuon]] suddenly so interested in Mat? She recognizes him. How? This is because of  [[Lidya]]'s [[Foretelling]], which Tuon heard right before docking in Ebou Dar}} Too quickly, she offers to buy him as ''[[da'covale]]''. Tylin refuses, saying he is a free man. Mat snorts, wondering really how free he is when he is on a bed with Tylin. The ladies leave, and as she passes by, Mat tells Tylin of the ''[[gholam]]''. She leaves, and soon a maid comes in with pink ribbons to dress Mat in. He groans.
